method: Real store/adapter/renderer with local shipped data and controllable native-DOM boundary fixtures; no browser automation.

checks.name: Cold reader requests only its index and shows five exact starter phases
One Ming phase requests one small shard and bounds visible records to 24
Simplified phase lookup finds Ming without changing source names
Local filters export full original typed rows and full raw phase metadata
Global Crisis search reads only its relevant sheet and exports all hits only on request
Global typing cancels stale work immediately and debounces the newest query
Chinese composition waits for completion before launching global search
Rapid phase changes, clear selection and destroy reject late UI writes
Index and phase failures have working explicit retry paths
Global failure retries without pretending that the archive is empty
All seven empty phases retain their source metadata without an error state
Mobile phase selector stays visible while labelled advanced filters begin closed
Language changes retain filters, page, disclosure and input focus
Snapshots restore global filters and pagination and reject excessive page values
Restored excessive global page clamps before the store range check
Restored global domain and query pages clamp to actual hits, including zero
Native arrow keys stop map propagation without cancelling normal controls
Hostile source text, unknown codes and details stay inert text
Numeric endpoint order, year zero, one-sided date and source flags stay distinct
Flag badges require the signed boolean cell type and never coerce string codes
Date labels distinguish BCE, CE, missing endpoints and undated observations
Crisis renders all 21 raw string outcomes without boolean coercion
Explicit cross-version comparison delegates the exact reviewed phase pair
An export failure can retry, and a changed selection cancels a stale global export
Destroy during index read prevents all later DOM and selection writes
